::: about-me-text
Hello! I'm David, a research associate at the [Chair of Policy Analysis and Political Economy](https://sowi.rptu.de/en/dpts/political-science/home/faculty) at RPTU Kaiserslautern-Landau and a PhD student in Political Science at the [GESS](https://www.uni-mannheim.de/gess/), University of Mannheim. 

Previously, I taught seminars at the [Chair of Comparative Government](https://www.sowi.uni-mannheim.de/en/debus/) in Mannheim, worked in the ERC project [Pergap](https://inequalityhub.org/project/), and was a PhD trainee at the European Central Bank.

My research explores how climate change, digitalization, and EU Cohesion Policy affect party competition, political behavior, and political communication.
:::
